tasks.short: Develop marketing strategy from market evidence, business priorities, product strengths and regulatory constraints.

steps.what: Review product information, market research, competitor material and regulatory guidance.

loop.input: Selected source documents with dates and source identifiers.
loop.output: Evidence brief with citations, uncertainties and conflicting claims.
loop.check: Check citation coverage automatically; the manager verifies material claims and source suitability.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass per brief; unresolved claims return to manual research.
loop.why_not_simpler: The sources contain prose and conflicting interpretations that fixed extraction rules cannot reliably summarise.

steps.what: Review channel response, campaign spend and commercial results.
Agree business objectives, customer priorities and delivery constraints with stakeholders.
Compare positioning, audience and channel options and select a recommended approach.
Write the strategy, campaign priorities, assumptions and success measures.

loop.input: Selected strategy, evidence brief, constraints and strategy template.
loop.output: Strategy draft with linked evidence, assumptions and proposed measures.
loop.check: Validate figures against the baseline and claims against sources; the manager checks strategic fidelity.
loop.stop: One draft and two revisions; unresolved sections return to the manager.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template supplies structure, but explaining strategic choices requires contextual prose.

steps.what: Challenge trade-offs and approve the strategy and resource envelope.
Publish the approved strategy internally and create campaign planning actions.

tasks.design: Configure a channel baseline in the {BI} using the {ADS}, {MARKETING_AUTOMATION} and {ERP}, and generate cited evidence briefs from the {DOCS}. Bounded drafting loops prepare the strategy document; people choose the approach and approve resources before the {PROJECT} receives campaign actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence was scattered, channel definitions differed, and producing a coherent strategy document required manual synthesis.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing connectors and templates handle repeatable preparation. Bounded models can draft cited summaries, while AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of building small integrations.
tasks.still_hard: Positioning, uncertain market signals, regulatory interpretation and competing stakeholder priorities remain difficult. Early results rarely prove that a strategy caused the outcome.
tasks.human_edge: Choose which uncertainty to accept, identify credible differentiation and secure commitments from people with competing priorities.

ambition.what: Monthly channel experiment reprioritisation using refreshed evidence.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less evidence assembly and document production, leaving more time for strategic alternatives and experiment reviews. Decision rights remain unchanged unless leadership delegates a bounded experiment budget.

reach.task: Design a small customer study to test a positioning assumption.
reach.learn: Sampling, interview design and the difference between stated preference and observed behaviour.

reach.task: Substantiate an environmental claim before it enters a campaign brief.
reach.learn: Evidence boundaries, qualification of claims and escalation of unsupported statements.

evidence.claim: Standardised channel data and automated reporting are available capabilities.
Campaign-plan drafting is available; this does not establish reliable autonomous strategic judgement.
A strategy workflow can combine deterministic reporting with bounded drafting and human strategic decisions.

assumptions: A typical mid-size company has periodic strategy approval and more frequent campaign adjustments.
Approved source documents and usable channel exports are available.
Strategy review covers GDPR, ePrivacy and applicable EU AI Act requirements.
Build ranges are planning estimates for a limited pilot; access and applicable consultation may extend elapsed time.
The priors support drafting assistance, but strategic choice and stakeholder alignment retain substantial human time.
unknowns: Which channel, finance and research sources can be accessed?
Who approves strategy, claims and resource changes?
Are customer-level data necessary, and what processing permissions apply?
Can the manager receive delegated authority for bounded experiments?
research_questions: Which channel measures remain comparable after consent restrictions and attribution differences?
Can the document store preserve citations and source versions through revisions?
Which national consultation requirements apply to the proposed deployment?
new_work: Verify source dates, citations and material claims.
Maintain channel definitions and integration mappings.
Record assumptions and review them against subsequent results.
Update templates and checks when regulatory guidance changes.

tasks.short: Mobilise the campaign team, resolve blockers and maintain progress towards campaign goals.

steps.what: Review campaign milestones, outstanding work and delivery risks.
Chase routine progress updates through messages.
Align the team on campaign goals, responsibilities and dependencies.
Coach contributors, resolve conflicts and negotiate help for blocked work.
Approve priority, ownership and schedule changes within delegated limits.
Update task owners, due dates and dependencies after decisions.
Send stakeholders milestone updates and escalation notices.

tasks.design: Configure owner updates, dependency views and milestone alerts in the {PROJECT}, with targeted notices through the {CHAT} and {EMAIL}. Structured delivery decisions update the campaign plan automatically; alignment, coaching and resource negotiations remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress lived in conversations, task records were stale, and ownership was inconsistent. Software could send reminders but could not create team commitment.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing project workflows can replace duplicate reporting once owners maintain one delivery record. AI-assisted configuration and small integrations reduce setup effort; a model loop is unnecessary.
tasks.still_hard: People may withhold bad news, priorities can conflict, and external dependencies remain uncertain. A current task board cannot resolve motivation or trust.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when a delivery problem reflects confidence, conflict or workload, and negotiate a workable commitment.

ambition.what: A weekly cross-functional campaign blocker clinic.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time collecting updates and more time coaching and resolving dependencies. Existing authority over priorities and schedules remains unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate a campaign event's critical path and contingency plan.
reach.learn: Dependency planning, supplier lead times and event readiness decisions.

reach.task: Plan creative review capacity against campaign milestones.
reach.learn: Creative iteration, feedback quality and realistic production lead times.

evidence.claim: Configured project records, dependency views and rule-based notices can reduce routine coordination work.
Coaching, conflict resolution and negotiating commitments remain human work.

assumptions: Campaign contributors can update shared task records directly.
Routine chasing disappears only after owner updates and automatic reminders replace duplicate status requests.
Exceptional non-response still requires personal follow-up.
Delivery visibility uses task records; changes affecting employee monitoring require GDPR and national-rules assessment.
Build ranges include access review and applicable employee consultation; formal procedures may take longer.
The people-heavy prior fits this task; workflow automation changes preparation and paperwork.
unknowns: How current and complete are task records?
Which priority and staffing changes can the manager approve?
Does the proposal change employee monitoring or reporting obligations?
Which employee representatives and access owners must be involved?
research_questions: Can the existing project system apply structured decisions without duplicate entry?
Which reminder and escalation rules reduce chasing without creating excessive notifications?
Which national consultation requirements apply to task-level delivery visibility?
new_work: Handle missing updates and exceptional dependency failures.
Maintain task templates, escalation thresholds and owner mappings.
Remove redundant alerts and obsolete reporting requests.
Review access and retention for delivery records.

tasks.short: Prepare campaign budgets, test cost assumptions and submit estimates for approval.

steps.what: Retrieve previous campaign costs, current commitments and budget limits.
Request supplier quotes and clarify scope, rates and commercial assumptions.
Enter quoted rates, quantities and exclusions into the budget workbook.

loop.input: Supplier quote documents and scope clarifications.
loop.output: Draft cost lines with units, currency, tax treatment, exclusions and source references.
loop.check: Validate required fields and arithmetic; the manager confirms material rates, exclusions and ambiguous terms.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass per quote; ambiguous lines return for manual entry.
loop.why_not_simpler: Supplier quotes use varied layouts and prose qualifications. Structured supplier forms would remove this loop.

steps.what: Calculate campaign costs, contingencies and alternative spend scenarios.
Choose scope, contingency and trade-offs against campaign objectives.
Prepare the budget submission with assumptions and supporting quotes.
Review affordability, challenge assumptions and approve the campaign budget.
Record the approved estimate against the campaign and cost centre.

tasks.design: Read commitments and actuals from the {ERP} and {PROCUREMENT}, then calculate scenarios with a versioned cost model on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded quote-extraction loop supplies reviewed cost lines, deterministic templates produce the submission in the {DOCS}, and an approved budget updates the {ERP} and {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supplier quotes differed in format, cost models were copied between workbooks, and finance records needed manual reconciliation.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic calculation and document generation were already feasible. Cheaper integration work and bounded extraction make the remaining document handling practical.
tasks.still_hard: Quotes may exclude production changes, usage rights or cancellation costs. Forecast response and the right contingency remain judgement calls.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate comparable scope, challenge optimistic assumptions and choose which campaign risks deserve contingency.

ambition.what: Refresh campaign cost-to-complete decisions whenever a material supplier quote changes.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time entering rates, repairing formulas and formatting submissions, and more time negotiating scope and evaluating alternatives. Spending and budget approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Compare campaign investment options against commercial objectives.
reach.learn: Contribution margin, incremental returns and sensitivity analysis.

reach.task: Build an event cost estimate with cancellation and attendance scenarios.
reach.learn: Fixed versus variable costs, contractual deadlines and contingency planning.

evidence.claim: Versioned rules can calculate quantities, rates, tax assumptions, contingencies and scenario totals without a model.
Variable supplier documents can use bounded extraction with source references and human confirmation.

assumptions: The budget workbook is a typical bridge between supplier documents and finance records.
Finance supplies approved currency, tax, contingency and cost-centre rules.
The extraction loop is needed only for quotes without reliable structured fields.
GDPR and applicable EU AI Act requirements are assessed for the actual data and use.
Build estimates cover a limited campaign-cost model, access review and applicable national consultation.
The automation prior fits calculation and submission preparation; commercial negotiation and approval remain human.
unknowns: Which finance exports or interfaces are available?
How many suppliers provide structured quotes?
Which tax, currency and contingency rules apply?
Who approves budgets, and what are the approval thresholds?
Do access changes trigger employee consultation under national rules?
research_questions: Can existing finance configuration provide scenario calculation and submission templates?
How reliably can quote exclusions and usage-rights terms be extracted from representative documents?
Can approved estimates be written back with version history and duplicate prevention?
new_work: Review extracted rates, exclusions and ambiguous quote terms.
Maintain calculation rules, templates and approved rate tables.
Reconcile failed or duplicate finance updates.
Review scenarios when campaign scope or supplier terms change.

tasks.short: Maintain a searchable campaign portfolio with reusable assets, results, rights and lessons.

steps.what: Collect campaign briefs, final assets and approval records from contributors.
Create or update portfolio entries with campaign identifiers, owners, dates and asset links.
Write campaign summaries, add subject tags and capture lessons.

loop.input: Campaign source pack, retrospective and approved portfolio taxonomy.
loop.output: Draft summary, suggested tags and source-linked lessons.
loop.check: Validate tags against the taxonomy; the manager checks factual accuracy and separates reported lessons from inference.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass per entry; unclear lessons remain unclassified for manual review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Campaign narratives vary in wording and structure, so fixed metadata rules cannot capture their meaning.

steps.what: Attach campaign results and their measurement definitions to portfolio entries.
Review lessons, permissions and relevance before approving entries for reuse.
Publish entries and update access, review dates and archive status.
Notify relevant colleagues about newly available examples and reusable assets.

tasks.design: Configure campaign records, rights fields and review dates in the {DOCS}, linked by campaign identifier to the {PROJECT} and {BI}. Deterministic collection and notifications maintain the portfolio, while a bounded loop proposes summaries and tags for review before entries are approved for reuse.
tasks.previous_blocker: Files lacked consistent identifiers, campaign results were separate from assets, and maintaining descriptions competed with live campaign work.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured records and small integrations can maintain metadata and links. Bounded classification reduces the cost of describing varied campaign material.
tasks.still_hard: Asset rights may be incomplete, performance definitions change, and a successful campaign may not transfer to another audience or period.
tasks.human_edge: Choose which examples deserve reuse and explain the context that made them effective.

ambition.what: Give newly hired campaign contributors a curated, searchable campaign learning collection.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time collecting files and repairing entries, and more time curating examples and teaching campaign lessons. Decision rights over publication and reuse remain unchanged.

reach.task: Curate a concise campaign learning collection for new contributors.
reach.learn: Editorial selection, information hierarchy and consistent metadata.

reach.task: Identify assets suitable for adaptation to another campaign.
reach.learn: Source-file requirements, usage rights and limits on visual adaptation.

evidence.claim: Standardised marketing results can feed linked campaign reporting.
Configured document records can maintain metadata, access, review dates and internal publication workflows.
Bounded classification can propose summaries and tags while people decide suitability for reuse.

assumptions: Final assets and approvals are stored in accessible repositories.
Campaign identifiers can connect assets, project records and results.
Automatic collection links authorised source locations and preserves their access restrictions.
GDPR, applicable EU AI Act duties and national rules inform access, retention and consultation decisions.
Build ranges assume a limited portfolio pilot; historical cleanup and formal consultation may extend rollout.
The record-management prior fits much of the task, while interpretation and reuse decisions stay human.
unknowns: How consistently are campaigns identified across systems?
Which asset rights and approvals are recorded?
Who may access historical campaign material?
How large and inconsistent is the existing portfolio?
Are employee or customer identities embedded in assets or retrospectives?
research_questions: Can existing document configuration support the required metadata, permissions and review dates?
Can result links preserve measurement definitions and reporting periods?
Which taxonomy produces useful retrieval for new contributors?
Which national consultation requirements apply to the proposed access and processing changes?
new_work: Review generated summaries, tags and proposed lessons.
Resolve missing rights, source files and campaign identifiers.
Maintain taxonomy, retention rules and review schedules.
Repair broken links and refresh outdated examples.

role.altitude: The role shifts time from assembling evidence, budgets and campaign records towards strategic choices, coaching and commercial trade-offs. Approval rights remain unchanged unless leadership explicitly delegates bounded campaign decisions.
reach: Market Research Analyst: test positioning assumptions with customer evidence.
Marketing Manager: connect campaign cost scenarios to commercial priorities.
Editor: curate campaign knowledge for new contributors.
Meeting, Convention, and Event Planner: coordinate dependencies and contingency plans.
skills_to_grow: Experiment design and interpretation of uncertain campaign results.
Commercial cost modelling and supplier scope negotiation.
Evidence checking, claim substantiation and source management.
Workflow configuration, structured records and exception handling.
Coaching, conflict resolution and cross-functional negotiation.
role.ambitious_version: Run a continuous campaign learning cycle: refresh evidence, compare costed experiments, resolve delivery blockers and turn completed campaigns into reusable lessons. Seek explicit delegation for reversible experiment changes within approved budgets.
